# Enfield Nails

> Nail studio based in Austin, Texas. A light, airy Clarksville studio for manicures, pedicures, SNS dip, full sets and nail art. Gentle hands, polish that lasts, and walk-ins welcome seven days a week.

- Phone: (512) 551-3226
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Clarksville, Downtown Austin, Tarrytown, Old West Austin, Bryker Woods
- Google rating: 4.2 from 165 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/enfield-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/enfield-nails/book.html

## Services
- Manicures: Classic, deluxe, French and shellac or gel manicures, shaped and finished with care.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with a massage that out-of-town guests and regulars rave about.
- SNS dip & gel: SNS dip powder and gel color that holds up for weeks. Regulars ask for Katie and Bong by name.
- Full sets & fills: Full sets, fills and extensions in the shape and length you want.
- Nail art: Ombre, chrome, holiday sets and hand-painted designs, right down to the cover of the book you are reading.
- Waxing & brows: Quick waxing and eyebrow shaping while you are here. Ask at the front desk for what is on today.

## About
Enfield Nails is a family-owned nail studio on West 12th Street in Clarksville, run by Holly and her sister Tee. Inside it is bright and open: white walls, a mezzanine overhead, honey-wood manicure tables and a big wall of polish. A lot of the team came over from Tarrytown Nails, and so did their regulars. Some guests have been coming for eight years and still ask for the same tech by name: Katie for dip, Bong for SNS, Abby, Annie and T for manicures and pedicures. Neighbors from 78703 stop in after work, brides come in before the big day, and guests from the downtown hotels walk over for a pedicure. Reviewers keep coming back to the same things: kind, organized techs, gentle cuticle work, relaxing massages and polish that lasts for weeks.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. For a group or a set time, call (512) 551-3226 or book online to save your spot.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM and Sunday 11 AM to 5 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call ahead if you are not sure.
- Q: Where are you and where do I park?
  A: 916 W 12th St, Austin, TX 78703, in Clarksville just west of downtown. Look for the white ENFIELD NAILS sign on the gray slat facade.
- Q: Can I bring a group?
  A: Yes. Groups and parties come in often; call ahead or book so the team can have enough techs ready.
- Q: Can I request a specific tech?
  A: Yes. Plenty of regulars ask for the same tech every visit. Mention their name when you call (512) 551-3226 or when you walk in.
- Q: Do you do SNS dip and nail art?
  A: Yes: SNS dip powder, gel, full sets and fills, ombre, chrome and hand-painted designs. Bring an inspiration photo.
- Q: I'm staying downtown. Is it close?
  A: Yes. The studio is a short drive or ride from downtown Austin hotels, and out-of-town guests stop in for pedicures all the time.
- Q: Do you do men's manicures and pedicures?
  A: Yes. Men's manicures and pedicures are on the menu, and plenty of guys are regulars.
